title: Sphinx Artist in Studio
description: A hairless sphynx cat wearing glasses stands at a wooden drafting table, holding a yellow pencil in its paw and drawing on a large sheet of paper covered with repeated sketches of a woman in an orange dress carrying a handbag. The black background features floating transparent bubbles containing a screaming face, a muscular winged man, and a figure in blue robes with a white ruff collar, along with geometric diagrams and mathematical notations.
prompt: A surreal scene of a hairless sphynx cat with glasses standing at a wooden artist's drafting table, carefully drawing with a yellow pencil on a large white sheet filled with multiple identical line drawings of a woman in an orange dress carrying a handbag, set against a dark background with floating transparent bubbles containing a screaming man's face, a muscular man with white wings, and a historical figure in blue robes with white ruff collar, surrounded by blue geometric circles, mathematical equations, and constellation lines in the style of a detailed oil painting
